description: Early medieval hanging lantern, lit: small round black iron cage ~0.16 m across and ~0.36 m tall to the top of its hanging ring; six straps and three bands, glowing amber horn panes, a door pane ajar at the front (-Y) showing a lit candle, a pierced conical top. Origin at its base: place the base at the hanging height under a beam.

paint.prompt: a sooty black hand-forged iron lantern with rust spots, thin translucent amber horn panes with streaks and mottling, a pale wax candle
